title: Walking Very Far
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about how to draw someone walking a long way off. Up close Lian is two blocks tall. Far away he is a tiny figure, 8 pixels high, on a pale ridge, and his steps are small and slow so the road looks long. In the last level a big fence and big flowers in front make him look farther still. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how far a step goes.

box.tagline: A long way off, in a few pixels.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks a road up close, then the same road on a far ridge where he is only a few pixels tall, with small slow steps and pale hills. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how far a step goes.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
The same walk up close and far away
Made to be copied and taken apart
